cases.name: Lorraine Marilyn Adams Redmann
cases.about: Her Find-a-Grave entry said, "She grew up in the White Lake area and graduated from White Lake high school. She received her teaching certificate. She married Roland Redmann on March 2,1952 in Wessington Springs. They farmed west of Wessington Springs before moving into town in 1986. She worked at the manor and volunteered at the library. She also enjoyed quilting, genealogy and especially her grandchildren."
cases.narrative: He broke into her home to confront his wife regarding his arrest after he violated a no-contact order, reportedly pushed his wife onto a couch, and when Redman came to check up on her granddaughter, Caffee fatally shot her.
